loyaltyProgramme.title: Loyalty Programme
loyaltyProgramme.summary: A native loyalty programme owned by a brand/retailer with configurable points rules, tier rules and redemption options.
loyaltyProgramme.description: A LoyaltyProgramme is the top-level container for one brand/retailer's loyalty economics. It owns its own PointsRule, TierRule and RedemptionOption collections; KlantLoyaltyAccount links a customer (klantId) to exactly one programme. Status transitions from concept→actief are validated against rule and redemption-option presence (REQ-LOY-001).

activate.description: Activate the programme (validated against rule and redemption-option presence, REQ-LOY-001).

programmeId.description: Stable external identifier for the programme. Used by POS terminals.

merk.description: Brand or retailer that owns the programme.

einddatum.description: ISO-8601 programme end date (null for open-ended).

valuta.description: ISO 4217 currency code for spend-based rules and liability.

termsUrl.description: URL to the programme's terms of service for opt-in capture.

brandingProfileId.description: Optional FK to a branding profile (logo/colours) for notifications and POS prints.

pointValue.description: EUR value of one point, used for IFRS 15 / RJ 270 liability calculation (REQ-LOY-009).

pointsRule.title: Points Rule
pointsRule.summary: A trigger-based rule that awards points; conditions filter applicability, formula derives the amount.
pointsRule.description: PointsRule defines when (trigger), under what conditions (JSON conditie), and how many points (JSON formule) are awarded. Rules are evaluated in priority order; the highest-priority matching rule wins (non-cumulative). See REQ-LOY-002.

ruleId.description: Stable external identifier for the rule.

trigger.description: Event type that fires the rule.

conditie.description: Optional JSON filter (category, excludeCategory, segment, dayOfWeek, timeRange, channel).

formule.description: Points formula. Supported types: fixed {value}, percentage {value}, stepped {brackets:[{amount,points}]}.

maxPerKlantPerPeriode.description: Optional cap on points awarded to a single customer per period (null = no cap).

prioriteit.description: Rule priority; HIGHER value wins. Highest-priority matching rule wins (non-cumulative).

tierRule.title: Tier Rule
tierRule.summary: A tier definition with threshold and benefits; benefits modify points multiplier and exclusive offers.
tierRule.description: TierRule defines a tier (e.g. Zilver, Goud, Platina) with a threshold against lifetimePoints, rolling-window points, or annual spend. Benefits include a points multiplier (applied to credit amount) and optional flags such as exclusiveOffers, freeShipping. See REQ-LOY-003.

tierId.description: Stable external identifier for the tier.

sequence.description: Order from lowest to highest; used to walk tiers in calculateTier.

benefits.description: Benefits JSON: pointsMultiplier (number), exclusiveOffers (bool), freeShipping (bool), etc.

klantLoyaltyAccount.title: Klant Loyalty Account
klantLoyaltyAccount.summary: A customer's enrollment in a loyalty programme; tracks balances, tier, and opt-in.
klantLoyaltyAccount.description: KlantLoyaltyAccount links one customer (klantId, references a Nextcloud contact UID) to one LoyaltyProgramme. currentBalance and lifetimePoints are denormalised for query performance; the immutable PointsLedgerEntry collection is the source of truth (REQ-LOY-002, REQ-LOY-005). Composite uniqueness on (klantId, programmeId).

currentBalance.description: Denormalised current points balance. Source of truth = sum of PointsLedgerEntry.aantal.

lifetimePoints.description: Cumulative points credited (never decreased on debit/expiry); used for tier thresholds.

status.description: Account status. Geblokkerd accounts do not earn points (REQ-LOY-002-05).

pointsLedgerEntry.title: Points Ledger Entry
pointsLedgerEntry.summary: Immutable, append-only entry recording every points movement (credit, debit, expiry, adjustment).
pointsLedgerEntry.description: PointsLedgerEntry is the authoritative ledger of points movements. Entries are immutable (write-once, no UPDATE/DELETE except for GDPR anonymisation of klantId). balansNa records the running balance after the entry was applied. brondocument links to the originating event (POS transaction, redemption, expiry batch, manual adjustment). See REQ-LOY-002, REQ-LOY-005, REQ-LOY-009.

klantId.description: Denormalised klantId for GDPR queries; anonymised on deletion.

aantal.description: Signed delta. Credit positive, debit/expiry negative, adjustment signed.

balansNa.description: Running balance AFTER this entry was applied.

regelId.description: Optional FK to PointsRule that produced the credit.

verwerktDoor.description: Who/what processed the entry (POS terminal id, system, user id).

redemptionOption.title: Redemption Option
redemptionOption.summary: A reward customers can buy with points (discount, free product, gift card, partner voucher).
redemptionOption.description: RedemptionOption defines what a customer can claim with points. kostenInPunten is the cost in points; beloningType/beloningWaarde define the reward; perKlantLimiet caps repeat redemptions. See REQ-LOY-004.

beloningWaarde.description: Reward value (number for discount, string for product name, etc.).

kostBasisEur.description: Estimated business cost in EUR for cost % reporting (REQ-LOY-008).

perKlantLimiet.description: Max times one customer can redeem this option (null = unlimited).

redemption.title: Redemption
redemption.summary: A claimed reward with status lifecycle (gereserveerd → gebruikt | vervallen | geannuleerd).
redemption.description: Redemption tracks one customer's claim against a RedemptionOption. On initiate, points are debited atomically (immutable PointsLedgerEntry of type 'debit') and a unique beloningCode is issued. Status transitions through gereserveerd → gebruikt (used) | vervallen (expired) | geannuleerd (cancelled, points refunded). See REQ-LOY-004.

beloningCode.description: Unique redemption code (UUID-derived, presented to POS).

giftCard.title: Gift Card
giftCard.summary: A gift card with hashed PIN and unique serial; balance is mutated via GiftCardTransaction (append-only).
giftCard.description: GiftCard tracks a stored-value instrument with serial (globally unique), PIN (bcrypt hashed, NEVER plaintext — REQ-LOY-006-04), initial balance, current balance, status (issued → active → depleted | blocked), and expiry. All balance movements are logged via GiftCardTransaction. See REQ-LOY-006, REQ-LOY-007.

programmeId.description: FK to LoyaltyProgramme (nullable; gift cards can be standalone).

pin.description: bcrypt PIN hash — never plaintext, never logged.

giftCardTransaction.title: Gift Card Transaction
giftCardTransaction.summary: Immutable, append-only ledger entry recording every gift-card movement.
giftCardTransaction.description: GiftCardTransaction logs every balance movement (issue, redeem, partial_redeem, refund, topup, block). Append-only — balance changes are reconstructable from the ledger. See REQ-LOY-006, REQ-LOY-007.
